missing_information_behavior: Do not present a strong recommendation when user context or evidence is insufficient.
safety_exclusions: Ingredient- and product-specific safety review remains required.
professional_escalation_conditions: Pregnancy or lactation, relevant disease, medication use, allergy or adverse reaction.
population_and_context: Oral collagen for skin-aging outcomes in adults; do not generalize to joint outcomes.
dose_constraints: No individualized dose supported by this rule.
certainty_and_limitations: Claim remains under evidence review; funding-source and study-quality subgroup findings challenge generic skin-aging benefit. No GRADE appraisal yet.
